description: AI-First Software Development Lifecycle — 6 tracks, 21 agents, 21 slash commands, human gates throughout. Supports greenfield, brownfield, UI modernization, legacy transformation, microservices decomposition, and cross-repository workflows.

agents.00_onboarding: Existing project mid-pipeline entry — maps existing docs to SDLC artifact structure
agents.00b_context_bridge: Cross-repository context sharing — Export and Import modes
agents.00c_intelligent_context_extractor: Codebase intelligence extraction — dependency graph, git analytics, auto-generated docs, architectural decisions, code health signals
agents.00d_context_snapshot: Session continuity — multi-session project state capture and resume
agents.06_task_breakdown: Phase 6 — Sprint planning and task breakdown
agents.07_implementation: Phase 7 — Development with full human gates
agents.08_code_review: Phase 8 — Code review (Single Task, Full Sprint, Branch/PR modes)
agents.09b_test_automation_agent: Phase 9 — QA automation scripts generation agent
agents.10_security: Phase 10 — Security review (SAST, SCA, SBOM, STRIDE, OWASP)
agents.11_cicd: Phase 11 — CI/CD pipeline design and implementation

humanGates.policy: No phase, action, or destructive operation proceeds without explicit human approval — reply APPROVED
humanGates.note: Partial agreement ('looks good', 'yes', 'ok') is not APPROVED. The exact phrase APPROVED must be used to advance past a Human Gate.

sessionContinuity.policy: Run /sdlc:snapshot at the end of every session. Begin every new session with the resume phrase above.

intelligenceLayers: dependency-graph — module map, PageRank centrality, architecture communities, coupling analysis
git-analytics — hotspots (churn × complexity), ownership %, co-change pairs, bus factor
auto-generated-docs — per-module and per-file wiki, freshness scoring, semantic search
architectural-decisions — discovered from history, comments, and commit messages
code-health — dead code detection, cyclomatic complexity, unreferenced exports
mcpTools: get_overview() — architecture summary, module map, entry points
get_context(targets) — docs, ownership, decisions, freshness for any targets
get_risk(targets) — hotspot score, dependents, co-change partners, blast-radius
get_why(query) — architectural decisions governing a file or matching a concept
search_codebase(query) — semantic search over the full generated wiki
get_dependency_path(from, to) — connection path between two files or modules
get_dead_code() — unreachable code ranked by confidence and cleanup impact
get_architecture_diagram(module) — Mermaid diagram for repo or specific module
codbaseIntelligenceEngine.autoUpdateHook: Install the engine's git commit hook for incremental updates on every commit (<30 seconds after first index)

ruleFiles.loadingPolicy: Both rule files are pre-loaded via CLAUDE.md preamble. All agents apply rules from session start without per-agent re-reading.
ruleFiles.modificationPolicy: Do not modify either rule file without full team review — changes affect all 21 agents simultaneously.

contextBridge.exportRepo: Source repository that defines the API contract (typically frontend or primary service)
contextBridge.importRepo: Target repository that implements the contract (typically backend, mobile, or secondary service)
contextBridge.versioningPolicy: Semantic versioning — major bump for breaking changes, minor for additive, patch for corrections
contextBridge.stalenessPolicy: Re-export and re-import after any sprint that changes the API contract
